title: UAE Property Deals
description: Listings compared with real sales of the same layout.

emirate.title: Emirate
emirate.description: Dubai listings are compared with real sales registered with the Dubai Land Department. Abu Dhabi and Sharjah sales are not published there, so listings are compared with other listings of the same layout.

areas.title: Areas
areas.description: Communities or buildings as Property Finder names them: dubai-marina, jumeirah-village-circle, business-bay, al-reem-island, or a Property Finder search link. Empty: the whole emirate (large: set Maximum listings).

maxListings.title: Maximum listings
maxListings.description: Stop reading listings after this many. Each listing analysed is one result.

onlyBelowMarket.title: Save only listings below market
onlyBelowMarket.description: Save only listings at least Minimum discount below market with at least Minimum confidence. Off: every analysed listing is saved, with its market value and discount.

minDiscount.title: Minimum discount %
minDiscount.description: Used with Save only listings below market.

minConfidence.title: Minimum confidence
minConfidence.description: Used with Save only listings below market. In our checks, high and medium finds held up; low ones were hotel units, unverified listings or scattered comparables.

includeRentData.title: Rents and yields
includeRentData.description: Read each building's rent page too, for average rent, ROI and gross yield (one more page per building).

historyName.title: History name
historyName.description: Listings and deals are remembered in a key-value store of this name in your account: price changes show, and each building's deal history grows beyond the 10 sales a page shows. Use another name for a separate project.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: The Actor connects directly at a gentle pace. Turn on a proxy only if you need it.
